Historical public catalogue capture, 2026-11-24

The 475 rows in historical-public-partial.txt were produced from the
unmodified manufacture implementation at
f8ddbbbba211d5cb4ec6ca0a1775303ff6fce4b4, on Darwin arm64, Go 1.27.3,
GOWORK=off and GOMAXPROCS=2. They contain 455 geometry hashes and 20
expected Make refusals, with original refusal strings. Names were selected
from the intersection of the public-kind inventory and the kinds missing an
existing record. Each kind uses seeds 5 and 11 and requested details hull,
clumps, quick and demo. The records omit exactly bridge 5/11 demo and
scavenged-cluster 11 hull/quick/demo; those are addressed separately below.

The producer starts from the retained public geometry_sample.go and changes
only selection and two additive shape encodings: tag 4 and Radius for a
Sphere, and tag 5 followed by Radius, Thick, Height for a Tube. Older shape
tags and bytes are unchanged. Earlier filtered producers lacking those tags
never returned a row for unsupported shapes. An existing mesh row and a
Sphere row were checked byte for byte after the Tube addition. The Sphere
and Tube literal-byte and changed-dimension tests passed under Game.

Each case ran in its own process through a per-kind Game tests-lane ticket.
The driver retained individual rows and errors, stopped if free disk fell
below 30 GiB, and bounded each case to 120 seconds and 4 GiB sampled RSS.
The 475 successful case times sum to 276.422 seconds, including the driver's
polling floor but excluding lane waits and failed attempts. The largest
sampled successful peak was 1,671,648 KiB, scavenged-cluster 5 demo; the
longest successful case was bridge 5 quick at 15.322 seconds. RSS was
sampled every 0.2 seconds and can miss short-lived peaks; a zero sample is
not a measurement of zero memory.

The two bridge demos are supplied by reference from
historical-bridge-demo-arm64.txt and its separate provenance, committed at
35577d9c. They were captured from an optimized historical implementation,
not the unmodified f8 binary. Unmodified f8 produced no demo row within the
120-second bound. The three scavenged-cluster 11 cases failed in Things on
unmodified f8; their separately corrected-f8 rows and provenance are in
historical-corrected-scavenged-arm64.txt and its provenance companion.
Those three corrected rows must not be represented as unmodified successes.
